[chromosome 4](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Chromosome_4) [[7]](./CXCL10#cite_note-7) in a cluster among several other CXC chemokines. [[8]](./CXCL10#cite_note-pmid10343098-8)

[IFN-γ](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Interferon_gamma). These cell types include [monocytes](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Monocyte), [endothelial cells](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Endothelial_cell) and [fibroblasts](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Fibroblast).
